features.feature: Settings → Templates has tabs Minutes N, Meeting types N, Skills N
The minutes list shows each template as Built in, Edited or Yours with what it is for (any call no other matches, memos only, its title words, only when chosen)

The editor saves each change at once: the header card with its {values} (ⓘ inserts one), title words as chips (Enter or comma adds, × removes), sections (heading, what to write, ↑ ↓, trash but on the last, + Add a section)
Changing a built-in makes it Edited; Reset to built-in brings Echo's back; Delete moves the user's own to `.echo/trash/templates`; New template takes its id from its name
Meeting types lists Echo's six and the user's own, each with how to tell it; Name and How to tell it are edited; New, Reset to built-in, Delete
A call's minutes follow the template whose words are in its title, else Default (a template chosen for the call wins)
`echoctl templates` lists the templates, the values and the folder
